UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the FinTrack Personal application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. Uses path-based ownership for security. No denormalized authorization data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to manage user profiles securely and efficiently. The primary collection is `/users/{userId}`, which stores individual user profiles. This path-based ownership model provides excellent security and simplifies rules. This structure facilitates simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules. There is no denormalized authorization data. No collaborative data is present in this version.
